content.text:
The page looks like the approved baselines again. Both desktop and phone snapshots pass, with no pixel differences.

The cause was three bad values in `site/css/styles.css`, all Bootstrap defaults that had been altered:

1. **`--bs-body-color`** was `#d6dade` (very pale grey) instead of `#212529`. This made the heading and text look faded.
2. **`.container` `max-width` at 1200px and up** was `570px` instead of `1140px`. This squeezed the layout, so the navbar brand moved and the `h1` wrapped onto two lines.
3. **`.dropdown`, `.dropup` and the related classes** had `position: absolute` instead of `relative`. This made the Dropdown nav item overlap Home and Link.

I didn't touch the baselines, since none of the visual changes were intended.

STATUS: DONE
